title: Add filter controls to analytics dashboard

fields.title: Add filter controls to analytics dashboard
fields.description: Users need the ability to filter the analytics dashboard by date range, template type, and tags. Currently the dashboard shows all data without any way to narrow down the view.
fields.user_impact: Users with many captures cannot easily find patterns or focus on specific time periods. This is making the dashboard less useful as data grows.
fields.implementation_notes: Consider using a filter sidebar or dropdown controls. Date range picker should support presets like 'Last 7 days', 'Last month', etc.
